retainedFailures.observation: Changing the selected iframe left the initial viewport implementation waiting in the old frame until timeout. Bounded child observation leases and ancestor revalidation fix the reproduced case; both positive switch and late deselected-frame cases pass in the final matrix.

The initial unbounded control hung because document replacement restarted rather than retired an outstanding native observer. That development process was explicitly terminated. The final watchdog-bounded control passes with synchronous owned cleanup.

historicalRuns.note: Earlier final/formatted matrices and packed run predate the iframe correction and are retained privately, not used to establish the final implementation.

limitations: toHaveJSProperty and screenshot assertions remain unsupported.
toBeOK uses URL/status and bounded textual diagnostics; private reference fetch logs are not reproduced.
Selected native Linux full-Chrome runtime coverage only; no current complete-core, macOS, release or performance acceptance.
